user.title: Name your assistant
user.description: Everything else is optional and can be changed later.

data_description.assistant_name: Used when it speaks, on the dashboard, and in the instructions given to your language model.

hubbubb.name: Hubbubb (optional)
hubbubb.description: Connect your Hubbubb organisation so the assistant can answer questions about your records and correspondence. Create a client ID and secret in Hubbubb, then paste them here.

companion.name: Companion (optional)
companion.description: Only if you run the companion daemon on a computer with a coding agent on it. Without one, everything works except the build screen.

error.hubbubb_incomplete: Hubbubb needs all three: endpoint, client ID and client secret.
error.hubbubb_auth: Hubbubb refused those credentials, or could not be reached.
error.companion_unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check the host and port, and that the companion is running and reachable from Home Assistant.
error.companion_refused: The companion answered but refused the request — usually a wrong token.

abort.already_configured: Hubbubb Home is already set up.

data_description.prompt: Given to your language model alongside Home Assistant's own instructions. Write the assistant's name as a placeholder in curly braces and it will be filled in.

sentences.name: Voice sentences
sentences.description: Turn one off if your setup already answers those phrases with its own intents — two files claiming one phrase means one of them loses, silently. The Apple TV sentences are not here: picking Apple TVs below is their own opt-in. Takes effect after a restart.

data.house: House ("how's the house", build mode, ask Hubbubb)

announcements.name: Agent announcements
announcements.description: How a finished coding-agent turn reaches you.

data.notify_service: Phone push when the announcement switch is off
data.ack: Spoken when speech is handed to the coding agent

data_description.notify_service: A notify service like notify.mobile_app_your_phone. Blank means switched-off announcements are simply dropped.
data_description.ack: The real answer is announced later, when the turn actually finishes. Blank for a silent handoff.
data_description.quiet_start: Between these times, announcements are pushed silently to the phone instead of spoken. Set both the same to disable.

overnight.name: Overnight sweep
overnight.description: Once a night, look for things that have gone offline or stopped changing. It only ever reports.

data.ignore: Ignore these (one entity ID or pattern per line)

data_description.quiet_findings: Off: only devices stuck unavailable or unknown are reported; the went-quiet-versus-its-habits detector is muted.
data_description.drift_findings: Also check settings that have to hold a value: the Arlo cameras' ffmpeg option, and whether every Hue bulb is in the all-lights group.
data_description.drift_repair: Add a newly paired Hue bulb to the group and reload. This writes to configuration.yaml. Turn it off to be told instead of fixed.

briefing.name: Morning briefing
briefing.description: Weather, today's calendar, and what the sweep found - spoken through a voice satellite.

data_description.briefing_target: One or more voice satellites or speakers. Also where finished timers announce themselves.
data_description.tts_entity: Only needed if you chose a speaker — a satellite has its own voice, a speaker needs one picking.
data_description.person_calendars: One line per person: Name: calendar.theirs, calendar.other. The briefing reads each person their own day, and "what's my day" answers with theirs.

voice.name: Speaker identification
voice.description: Who is talking. Needs the voice service running on the companion computer — leave the URL blank and everything works exactly as before, with no idea who is speaking.

data_description.voice_service_url: Where the voice service answers, like http://mac.local:10301. Blank turns speaker identification off.
data_description.speaker_map: A fallback when the voice is not recognised: the assist device in someone's own room probably hears them. Device IDs are on each device's page.
data_description.approvers: Each person's own device, for tap-to-approve. With any line here, Hubbubb requests by voice need the speaker recognized (90% or a spoken "this is...") and then approved on their device. Blank turns the gate off.
data_description.token: A shared secret between this integration and the voice service. Speaker events without it are dropped, so nothing else on the network can claim to be a voice. Blank skips the check.
data_description.person_lists: "Add milk to my list" lands on the speaker's own to-do list. Create lists under Settings → Devices & Services → Local To-do, then map them here.
data_description.household_list: The shared list — "the shopping list", and the fallback when the speaker has no list of their own.

apple_tv.name: Apple TV
apple_tv.description: Pick your Apple TVs and the assistant answers "play …", "open netflix", "pause the apple tv" itself — music plays natively in the tvOS Music app. Each box's room name comes from its Home Assistant area. Takes effect after a restart (the voice sentences are generated from this list).

data.oauth_client_id: OAuth client ID (Sign in with Hubbubb)

data_description.people: One line per person: Name: client_id : client_secret. Each maps to that person's own Hubbubb user; when any line is set, voice requests run as the verified speaker and never as the shared client.
data_description.oauth_client_id: One OAuth client for the whole house, registered by an administrator in Hubbubb with this Home Assistant's /api/hubbubb_home/oauth/callback as a redirect URI (the Voice Studio shows the exact address). With it set, people link themselves by signing in to Hubbubb from the Voice Studio instead of pasting a key.

error.hubbubb_incomplete: Hubbubb needs all three: endpoint, client ID and client secret.
error.hubbubb_auth: Hubbubb refused those credentials, or could not be reached.
error.companion_unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check the host and port, and that the companion is running and reachable from Home Assistant.
error.companion_refused: The companion answered but refused the request — usually a wrong token.

remember.name: Remember
remember.description: Store one durable fact about the household.

forget.name: Forget
forget.description: Delete the memory that best matches a description.

name.name: Name
name.description: The timer's name; the next to finish if left blank.

timer_add.name: Add time
timer_add.description: Add or remove time on a running countdown.

ask_hubbubb.name: Ask Hubbubb
ask_hubbubb.description: Put a plain-English request to Hubbubb.

run_sweep.name: Sweep the house
run_sweep.description: Run the overnight checks now. Changes nothing.

speak_briefing.name: Speak the briefing
speak_briefing.description: Say the morning briefing now, and return its text.

agent_prompt_direct.name: Prompt the agent
agent_prompt_direct.description: Send text straight to the current session.

agent_upload.name: Upload to the agent
agent_upload.description: Send a file to the session.

agent_key.name: Send a key
agent_key.description: Press a key in the session.
